22.why_open: Remote server access ke liye use hota hai
22.who_exploits: Attackers brute force se password guess karte hain
22.risk: Poora server compromise ho sakta hai
how_to_fix: Password auth band karo, SSH keys use karo

5432.why_open: Database server bahar expose ho gaya hai
5432.who_exploits: Attackers direct database access karte hain weak credentials se
5432.risk: Poora database leak — usernames, passwords, sensitive data
how_to_fix: PostgreSQL ko sirf localhost pe bind karo
pg_hba.conf mein external access band karo
Strong password set karo postgres user ka
Public internet pe kabhi expose mat karo

631.why_open: Printer sharing service chal rahi hai
631.who_exploits: Attackers printer via network access karte hain
631.risk: Unauthorized print jobs, network info leak
how_to_fix: Printer service disable karo agar use nahi kar rahe
Firewall se port 631 block karo externally
CUPS ko sirf localhost pe bind karo
